10:79.text: And Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every learned magician."

10:80.text: So when the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw down whatever you will throw."

10:81.text: And when they had thrown, Moses said, "What you have brought is
magic. Indeed, Allāh will expose its worthlessness. Indeed, Allāh does not amend the work of corrupters.

10:82.text: And Allāh will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."

10:83.text: But no one believed Moses, except
among his people, for fear of Pharaoh and his establishment that they would persecute them. And indeed, Pharaoh was haughty within the land, and indeed, he was of the transgressors.

10:84.text: And Moses said, "O my people, if you have believed in Allāh, then rely upon Him, if you should be Muslims

10:85.text: So they said, "Upon Allāh do we rely. Our Lord, make us not

10:86.text: And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people."

10:87.text: And We inspired to Moses and his brother, "Settle your people in Egypt in houses and make your houses
and establish prayer and give good tidings to the believers."

10:88.text: And Moses said, "Our Lord, indeed You have given Pharaoh and his establishment splendor and wealth in the worldly life, our Lord, that they may lead
astray from Your way. Our Lord, obliterate their wealth and harden their hearts so that they will not believe until they see the painful punishment."
